summary_1line: Sita passionately insists on accompanying Rama into exile, and moved by her unwavering resolve and devotion, Rama finally agrees and explains his duty to obey his father.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita clings to Rama and weeps, tears falling like crystal drops as her moon-like face withers in grief.
Sita declares that the thorny forest will feel like heaven beside Rama, imagining herself walking with him among wild trees and dust-covered paths.
Rama lifts the fainting Sita into his arms, moved by her devotion, and finally agrees to take her with him into exile.
